items.title: H3D Postdoctoral Fellowship in Medicinal Chemistry
items.org: University of Cape Town, H3D Centre
items.why: Africa’s leading drug discovery centre, with CADD and AI/ML mentorship built in. The post is chemistry-led (design and synthesis for malaria, TB, AMR), so pitch your modelling as the design engine.
items.note: Roughly R367,500 to R410,000 a year, tax-free. Another listing shows older dates, so confirm the closing date with H3D.

items.title: EMBL EIPOD-LinC Postdoctoral Fellowship
items.why: Interdisciplinary postdocs at EMBL sites. Opens 25 Nov 2026, so start drafting a computational proposal with a host group now.
items.note: Date comes from a listing site. Confirm at embl.org.

items.title: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowship
items.why: Funds life-science postdocs abroad. Your PhD must be under two years old and the host must be outside Nigeria. Your PhD finished in 2026, so you fit the window.
items.note: Hard deadline 22 Jan 2027 at 14:00 CET. You need a host lab that agrees to take you.

items.title: TWAS-FAPESP Postdoctoral Fellowship
items.why: For recent PhDs from developing countries, in all natural sciences. A route into a Brazilian drug discovery group.
items.note: Date read from the TWAS page. Check which TWAS call is currently open.

items.title: ICGEB Arturo Falaschi Postdoctoral Fellowships
items.org: ICGEB, Trieste, New Delhi, Cape Town
items.why: Biotechnology and life-science postdocs, including a Cape Town site. Opens January 2027.
items.note: Open to nationals of ICGEB member states only. Check that Nigeria qualifies.

items.title: MIDAS African Faculty Fellowship (Phase 2)
items.why: A year in Ann Arbor for African faculty, with a stipend of $35,000. Michigan runs a Center for Data-Driven Drug Development.
items.note: Phase 1 closed 5 Oct 2026. Phase 2 is only worth pursuing if you submitted Phase 1. Otherwise watch for the 2028 cohort.

items.title: Wits postdoctoral fellowship openings
items.why: Several project-based postdocs, including ML on mass spectrometry imaging data. Some stay open until filled.
items.note: Most listed closing dates have passed. Email the contact person to ask about open projects.

items.title: Computational Chemistry, Structural Biology and Drug Discovery Scientist
items.why: Remote, $45 to $90 an hour, and Nigeria is on the eligible list. This is expert review work for AI training, so treat it as paid side income that does not build your publication record.
items.note: Posted 9 Nov 2026. Includes a coding challenge.

items.title: Bioinformatics and Computational Chemistry reviewer for virtual training
items.why: A short docking and virtual screening training review using AutoDock Vina and PyMOL, which you already use. Pays $10 to $40 an hour for under a month.
items.note: Posted about two weeks before this snapshot. It may already be filled.

items.title: Scientist, Computational Chemistry (ARPA-H project)
items.why: Docking, MD, FEP and ML on structure-based projects. Your toolkit matches, but it asks for 2+ years of postdoc or industry experience.
items.note: Posted 13 May 2026, so it may be closed. Check the page.

items.title: Scientist, CADD and Cheminformatics
items.why: A near-perfect skills match with RDKit, ML and Schrödinger-type tools.
items.note: Based in Montreal or remote from Ontario only, so you would need to relocate or be work-authorised in Canada.

items.title: More remote chemistry expert roles open to Nigeria
items.why: A running list of about 36 remote contract roles for Nigerian applicants. Mostly AI-training work.
items.note: Updated daily on the source site.

items.title: TETFund National Research Fund 2026 (concept notes)
items.why: ₦10 billion pool for public-institution lecturers. Closed on 15 Oct 2026 with no extension. Prepare a drug discovery concept note now for the next cycle.
items.note: Closed. Register on nrf.tetfund.gov.ng early next time.

items.title: AACR Beginning Investigator Grant for Catalytic Research (BIG Cat)
items.why: $60,000 over two years for early-career African cancer investigators. Your DLBCL work is a direct fit, so watch for the next call.

items.title: MMV Malaria Drug Discovery Research Call (9th)
items.why: Funds African scientists for cheminformatics, virtual screening and modelling. Your method set fits well, so prepare a malaria target for the next call.

items.title: Ersilia, AITHYRA and H3D AI Incubator
items.why: A six-month programme (Feb to Jul 2027) that helps African scientists apply AI to their own therapeutic discovery projects. It is designed as an annual round.
items.note: Closed 19 Oct 2026. Watch for the next round.

items.title: AREF Essential Grant Writing Programme
items.why: Grant-writing training for early-career African health researchers. A good first step before a Wellcome or EDCTP application.
items.note: The 2026 call has closed. Watch for the 2027 call.
